review_trigger: re-evaluate before M14 implementation authorization; a compatible non-major fix invalidates the exception

exceptions.rationale: All 21 advisories patch only in Next 15.5.x/16.x (vulnerable range recomputed at the postcss-remediated lockfile: 9.5.0 - 15.5.20); the installed 14.x line has no compatible remediation per audit metadata. A Next major migration is excluded from this hygiene gate (frozen R2 policy decision) and requires a separately reviewed plan. The SoloRing app is local-first (no public self-hosted internet exposure of the Next server), which bounds but does not eliminate the accepted risk; this note is context, not a safety claim.
exceptions.invalidated_when: fixAvailable.isSemVerMajor == false for this finding, or any advisory gains a 14.x patched release
